# Getting help

- **Docs:** https://docs.cidoc.dev
- **Questions:** support@cidoc.dev
- **Bug or wrong diagnosis:** [open an issue](https://github.com/ci-doctor/ci-doctor/issues/new/choose)
- **Matcher missing or misfiring:** [ci-doctor/matchers](https://github.com/ci-doctor/matchers/issues)
- **Security:** see [SECURITY.md](../SECURITY.md), not an issue

Include the output of `ci-doctor report`, and redact secrets from any log you share.
